test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

This preoccupation with him was becoming an obsession (that was beginning to effect her ability) to take care of the house

options.text: that was beginning to affect her ability
which was beginning to effect her ability
which was begin to affect her ability

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. *"that was beginning to affect her ability."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"effect her ability" **is incorrect because** "effect" **is most commonly used as a noun meaning a result or outcome.
 
• However**, in this context,** we need a verb that indicates influence or change.
 
• The verb** "affect"** should be used to express that her obsession is beginning to influence or change her ability to take care of the house.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is:* 'This preoccupation with him was becoming an obsession that was beginning to affect her ability to take care of the house.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's an explanation for each option:
 
 
• **"Which was beginning to effect her ability" **- This is incorrect because it still uses **"effect"** instead of the correct verb **"affect".**
 
• **"Which was begin to affect her ability"** - This option is incorrect due to the grammatical error of using "begin" instead of "beginning". This phrase is in the past tense and needs to use "beginning".
